description: Post a drafted open call or pro ask as the account you act for: a competition is three Asks under one tag (the prize, the runners-up, the entries), a hire (every pro ask is one) is the entries alone; each holds its money until approval. One leg per call; call again until it says everything is posted. A call by invitation writes its list the moment the entries post, and prints the invite links. Pays in this network's own coin, said in dollars. With `pay_by: "card"` nothing is spent here: the whole call is saved and you get a link where the person pays by card and posts it. Requires `confirm` to restate the exact total from the preview. What cannot be asked: anything that targets, follows, watches or identifies a particular person (their home, car, number plate, workplace or routine), involves children, is sexual, violent or threatening, is unlawful, asks for anyone's personal data, or puts whoever does it in danger. Work never requires going onto private land. Every ask is screened before it is offered, and anyone can report one.

confirm.description: The exact total from the preview, e.g. '$4.70'. Omit to preview.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

pay_by.description: "card": spend nothing from this key. The whole call is saved and you get a link where the person pays by card and posts it from their own account.

plain_key.description: Post as this key itself, from its own money. Without a connection: a rehearsal. With one, only a review honours it, and only after the person said yes to this: the review posts from your own account (this key), which they fund, not from their account, and the AI decides each report alone, with no final OK from them. Any other call posts as the person who connected the key, and without either it is refused.

slug.description: The call's name, as draft_call gave it.
